newsitem.title: USA: Key begins tender offer for 14 pct senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Key begins tender offer for 14 pct senior notes.

text.p: Key Plastics Inc said Wednesday it has begun a cash tender offer and consent solicitation for all $65 million principal amount of its 14 percent senior notes due 1999.
Key will pay $1,090 per senior note and an additional $20 per $1,000 principal amount of senior notes to holders who consent to certain indenture amendments.
Key will also pay accrued interest to, but not including, the payment date on the senior notes.

In order to receive the full payment of $1,110 per $1,000 principal amount, holders must tender their notes on or prior to the consent expiration date of March 11,1997, unless extended, at 1700 EST/2200 GMT.
The tender offer will expire at midnight EST on March 18, 1997, unless extended.
